rv.q: This is a production expert at making one smile.

When it premiered at MCC in 2017 it was fresh, savvy, and funny. Almost a decade later in its Broadway debut, it's lost none of that, and White's production perhaps inevitably given the arc of those passing years adds sharpness to its cruelties and weight to its grief.
What we do have is marvelous. And Broadway does give the play an appropriate magnitude.
It's a tricky balance, one that White negotiates expertly for this high-energy Broadway revival.

cn.t: Critics praise this Broadway debut as a worthy homecoming that retains its fresh humor and savvy while gaining sharper edge. White's expert direction navigates the tricky tonal balance, matching the play's operatic scale with exuberant performances.
